func documentPath(_ window: AXUIElement) throws -> String? { nil }
// A fake app (pid 4242) whose focused and main window is pid 4343's element.
let appElement = AXUIElementCreateApplication(4242)
let windowElement = AXUIElementCreateApplication(4343)
func pidOf(_ e: AXUIElement) -> Int32 { var p: pid_t = 0; AXUIElementGetPid(e, &p); return p }
// realpath, not resolvingSymlinksInPath (which drops /private from /private/var).
let raw = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.path + "/nlc-focused-doc-fixture-\(getpid()).txt"
FileManager.default.createFile(atPath: raw, contents: Data())
let file: String = { let r = realpath(raw, nil)!; defer { free(r) }; return String(cString: r) }()
func run(_ failSetOn: Int32?, _ failResetOn: Int32?) -> String {
    var resets: [Int32] = []
    let why = focusedDocumentMismatch(pid: 4242, want: file, setTimeout: { e, t in
        let n = pidOf(e)
        if t > 0 && failSetOn == n { return .failure }
        if t == 0 { resets.append(n); if failResetOn == n { return .failure } }
        return .success
    }, copy: { e, name in
        (.success, windowElement as CFTypeRef)
    }, windowPath: { _ in file })
    return (why.isEmpty ? "accepted" : why) + " | resets=\(resets.sorted())"
}
let out: [String: String] = [
    "all fine": run(nil, nil),
    "app set fails": run(4242, nil),
    "window set fails": run(4343, nil),
    "app reset fails": run(nil, 4242),
    "window reset fails": run(nil, 4343),
]
try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: file)
print(String(data: try! JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: out, options: [.sortedKeys]), encoding: .utf8)!)
